title: Classic Greek Gigantes Bean Stew
description: A hearty, comforting Greek stew made with giant beans in a flavorful tomato sauce, typically served with fluffy rice.

ingredients.name: optional: lemon juice and chopped fresh parsley

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the flour and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the water or broth, giant beans, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30-40 minutes, or until the beans are tender.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with a squeeze of lemon juice and some chopped parsley, if desired.
